item.title: PM Modi Launches HPV Vaccine Drive for Girls From Ajmer; Why This Cervical Cancer Shot Is Crucial for Teenagers?
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched a nationwide free HPV vaccination drive for 14-year-old girls to prevent cervical cancer, which causes over 80,000 deaths annually in India. Targeting high-risk HPV strains 16 and 18, the voluntary programme aims to expand access, boost awareness, and strengthen long-term cancer prevention across the country.
